## Highlights

- 5-stage in-order RV64IMA_Zicsr_Zifencei core in Amaranth HDL: forwarding, load-use interlock,
  BTB + 2-bit prediction, M/S/U modes, precise traps, CLINT + PLIC interrupts.
- Sv39 MMU (ITLB/DTLB, hardware walker through the D-cache), 4 KiB I$ and write-back D$.
- 191/194 riscv-tests pass on the RTL with every commit checked against the golden ISS
  (the 3 failures are by design: misaligned accesses trap, no PMP).
- orbit-os (rv64 port) boots to its shell on the RTL in simulation, lockstep-checked.
- ECP5 (ULX3S 85F) synthesis, place-and-route and bitstream with the YoWASP tools; nextpnr reports
  27.63 MHz post-route against the 25 MHz board clock.

## Downloads

- `orbit_rv_soc.v` - the SoC as Verilog-2005 with the RAM bus as ports (as simulated).
- `orbit_rv_soc_bram.v` - the SoC with 256 KiB block-RAM main memory (as on the FPGA).
- `riscv-tests-rtl.json`, `perf.json`, `perf.md` - riscv-tests and IPC results regenerated in CI.
- `fpga-report.json`, `fpga-nextpnr.log` - utilisation and timing from nextpnr (empty RAM image).

## Not yet verified

- No bitstream has been run on a ULX3S; the board UART boot log is still to be captured.
- The Spike comparison runs only in CI (201/203 programs match; see [docs/verification.md](https://github.com/coopersimpson101-debug/orbit-rv/blob/main/docs/verification.md) for the two that are not required to).
